capabilities: rotate, pan and zoom a 3D vault graph
colour note nodes by folder and layer tag nodes
focus the active note with a pulse and sonar ping
highlight a node and its direct connections on hover
replay vault growth in creation order with timelapse mode
extras: Privacy section states the graph is built locally with no network requests. Manual installation instructions and demo links are provided in the README.
intentEvidence: adds a rotatable, graph-style view for exploring notes, links, backlinks, folders, tags, and vault growth over time
motivation: Built to make vault structure easier to explore from another angle, per the README's overview.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is two-dimensional, making it harder to visually scan large vault structures and see how folders, tags and links cluster.
summary: 3D graph view that renders the vault's notes, links, backlinks, folders and tags as a rotatable sphere with folder colours and a timelapse replay.
